create_memory_object: create a Memory object with wearer location, instance ID, category name, and associated images
initialize_memory_with_data: initialize a Memory instance with 3D bounding box, segmentation mask, and associated image data
visualize_segmented_objects: visualize objects with segmentation masks overlaid on their associated images using specified indices
access_memory_attributes: access Memory object attributes like wearer location, instance ID, category name, and associated images
display_object_visualization: display segmented object visualization by calling visualize_objects_with_seg method with object index list
